q: Which provision would the OGRA (Amendment) Bill introduced in Pakistan's Senate on 30 October 2026 insert into the OGRA Ordinance, 2002?
e: The proposed new Section 8A concerns quarterly gas-cost reviews. The bill was introduced, not enacted. Sources: Senate of Pakistan; Dawn.

q: According to Reuters, coordinated dockworkers' strikes on 30 October 2026 extended to ports in how many countries?
e: Reuters reported action across 113 ports in 22 countries, with disruptions including Greek ferry services. Source: Reuters, 30 October 2026.

q: Which Pakistani military spokesman described Iran–US mediation as cautiously optimistic in a Reuters interview published on 30 October 2026?
o: Air Chief Marshal Zaheer Ahmed Baber Sidhu
e: ISPR director-general Lieutenant General Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry used the description; he did not announce a peace settlement.

q: What provisional annual headline CPI inflation rate did Destatis report for Germany in October 2026?
e: Germany's Federal Statistical Office estimated October CPI inflation at 2.8% year-on-year; 3.3% was September's rate and 2.1% October's core inflation.

q: Off which UAE emirate was the main GEM NO. 2 oil slick concentrated in the 30 October 2026 official update?
e: The UAE's official statement located the principal slick off Umm Al Quwain, with some pollution extending toward neighbouring northern emirates.

q: How many districts were selected for Pakistan's polio vaccination campaign scheduled for 2–8 November 2026?
e: On 30 October, the health minister announced a campaign in 97 selected districts, targeting about 24 million children under five. These were targets, not completed results. Source: Radio Pakistan.

q: What capacity was specified for the Gilgit-Baltistan solar project reviewed by Pakistan's prime minister on 30 October 2026?
e: The prime minister directed faster completion of a 100 MW solar project. The plant was not announced as commissioned. Source: Radio Pakistan.

q: Objections to appearing alongside which foreign minister caused cancellation of the G20 group photo in Atlanta on 30 October 2026?
e: Delegations objected to appearing with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov, and the traditional photo was cancelled. Source: Reuters.

q: Which institution organised the 31 October 2026 event where Pakistan's information minister proposed a national cybersecurity awareness council?
e: PTA organised Cyber Security Awareness Week in Islamabad; the council remains a proposal. Source: Radio Pakistan.

q: Which teaching approaches did Pakistan's prime minister direct Daanish Schools to integrate on 31 October 2026?
o: Military cadet training across all grades
e: The directive concerned AI and IT teaching methods, not a completed implementation. Source: Radio Pakistan.

q: What was the value of the green-innovation start-up fund cited by Pakistan's climate minister on 31 October 2026?
e: Musadik Malik referred to a $10 million fund; this is not a verified amount disbursed. Source: Radio Pakistan.

q: Which province's previously imposed emergency and governor's rule did Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif defend on 31 October 2026?
e: The prime minister defended existing measures in KP; he did not announce a new imposition that day. Source: Dawn.

q: Until what date did India extend its duty-free cotton import window in the announcement reported on 31 October 2026?
e: India extended the cotton import duty waiver for two months through the end of December 2026. Source: Reuters.

q: At which security forum did Egypt's foreign minister warn against renewed US–Iran escalation on 31 October 2026?
e: Badr Abdelatty spoke at the IISS Manama Dialogue in Bahrain. Source: Reuters.

q: Which Polish institution was at the centre of the leadership dispute reported on 31 October 2026?
e: The suspension of the Constitutional Tribunal's president prompted competing claims by Poland's president and prime minister. Source: Reuters.

q: How many dengue deaths were reported for October 2026 in Bangladesh through the 30 October data cutoff?
e: Reuters reported 173 October deaths, exceeding September's 148; the surveillance figures were provisional. Source: Reuters.

q: Approximately how many police personnel did France deploy amid protests on 31 October 2026?
e: Reuters reported a deployment of approximately 70,000 police personnel. Source: Reuters.

q: Which city hosted the Quad foreign ministers' meeting that announced supply-chain and AI cooperation on 31 October 2026?
e: The Quad foreign ministers met in Atlanta and announced new supply-chain and trusted-AI initiatives. Source: Reuters.

q: How many Patriot PAC-3 interceptors were covered by the US sale approval announced late 30 October UTC (early 31 October PKT)?
e: The approved proposed sale covered 500 PAC-3 interceptors valued at about $2.1 billion; delivery had not occurred. Source: Reuters.

q: What partnership framework did EU and Canadian leaders launch at their 21st summit in Montreal on 30 October 2026?
e: The European Council's summit results confirm that the EU and Canada launched the Alliance for the Future; this did not confer EU membership on Canada.

q: What document concluded the G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta on 31 October 2026 after no joint communiqué was agreed?
e: The US presidency issued a chair's statement after ministers failed to reach consensus on a joint communiqué. Source: Associated Press.

q: Which foreign minister urged a Black Sea maritime ceasefire to protect grain shipments at the G20 meeting on 31 October 2026?
e: Polish Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski called for a ceasefire to enable grain shipments. No ceasefire agreement was reached. Source: Reuters.

q: Which country assumed the chairmanship of the Group of Twenty-Four (G-24) on 1 November 2026?
e: Pakistan assumed the G-24 chairmanship; Muhammad Aurangzeb identified priorities on development, multilateral governance and finance. Source: Dawn.

q: Which aircraft model arrived in Islamabad on 1 November 2026 as PIA's first Dreamliner?
e: PIA confirmed arrival of its first leased Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner as flight PK786. Source: Dawn.

q: How many children under five did Bannu's anti-polio campaign launched on 1 November 2026 aim to vaccinate?
e: The Bannu district administration reported a target of 228,000 children across 57 union councils; it was not a completed-vaccination figure. Source: Dawn.

q: According to the SECP classification reported on 1 November 2026, how many years of missing statutory filings could trigger 'inactive by registrar' status?
e: The SECP classified companies after failure to file annual returns and/or financial statements for four years. Source: Dawn.

q: What did seven core OPEC+ producers decide at their online meeting on 1 November 2026?
e: The seven producers maintained December 2026 targets; broader 2027 policy discussions remained pending. Source: Reuters.

q: Which country mediated the Iran–US discussions continuing in Doha on 1 November 2026?
e: Reuters reported that Iranian negotiators met Qatari mediators in Doha; no agreement had been finalised. Source: Reuters.

q: What does 'SIR' stand for in India's contested 2026 electoral-roll revision?
e: The Election Commission's electoral-roll exercise is known as Special Intensive Revision; its fairness is politically disputed. Source: Dawn / AFP.

q: What approximate share of the $6.3 billion in stolen tokens did Binance say it had covered before resuming withdrawals on 1 November 2026?
e: Binance said it had covered about 95% of the stolen assets, not the entire amount. Source: Reuters / Dawn.

q: How many Ukrainian regions did President Zelenskiy say suffered power-infrastructure strikes on 1 November 2026?
e: Reuters quoted Zelenskiy saying electricity infrastructure in four regions had been hit. Source: Reuters.

q: Which Ukrainian town was the focus of the local humanitarian ceasefire cited by Pope Leo on 1 November 2026?
e: Pope Leo referred to humanitarian aid and evacuations in Oleshky, where a limited local ceasefire had been arranged. Source: Reuters.

q: Which roadmap did parties adopt at biodiversity COP17 in Yerevan in October 2026?
e: At COP17 in Yerevan on 31 October 2026, parties adopted the Yerevan Pathway to accelerate the 23 Kunming–Montreal biodiversity targets for 2030. Source: Convention on Biological Diversity.

q: Which district reported Pakistan's eighth confirmed polio case of 2026 on 1 November?
e: On 1 November 2026, Pakistan reported its eighth polio case of the year, from Khyber district, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Source: Dawn.

q: Which district's deputy commissioner reported renewed Pakistan–Afghanistan border firing on 1 November 2026?
e: On 1 November 2026, the deputy commissioner of Lower South Waziristan reported a Pakistan–Afghanistan border exchange of fire. Source: Dawn.

q: Which UN mission began winding down on 1 November 2026 after the Security Council did not renew its Western Sahara mandate?
e: The UN Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara (MINURSO) began winding down on 1 November 2026 after its mandate expired on 31 October. Source: Reuters.

q: At which regional security forum did UAE adviser Anwar Gargash call for diplomacy on 1 November 2026?
e: On 1 November 2026, UAE diplomatic adviser Anwar Gargash urged diplomacy at the IISS Manama Dialogue in Bahrain. Source: The National.

q: Who took over the SCO Interbank Consortium chairmanship for 2026–27?
e: Dawn identified HBL chairman Sultan Ali Allana as the new SCO-IBC chair.

q: What duration was announced for the sub-national polio drive starting 2 November 2026?
e: Radio Pakistan confirmed the campaign would run for one week.

q: Which debt instrument did the finance minister identify for possible tokenisation on 2 November?
e: Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb said existing Eurobond debt was under review.

q: How many World Bank-funded projects did Sindh officials review on 2 November 2026?
e: Radio Pakistan reported 12 projects worth $3.85 billion.

q: What PM2.5 concentration accompanied Lahore's reported AQI of 535 on 2 November?
e: Dawn reported IQAir's 8 a.m. PM2.5 reading near 343 µg/m³.

q: At which Pakistani port was the proposed LNG storage terminal located?
e: Dawn reported a proposed LNG storage terminal at Port Qasim.

q: How many points were in the China–Oman statement issued during Sultan Haitham's Beijing visit?
e: Reuters reported a 20-point joint statement on 2 November.

q: How much oil did ADNOC's chief executive estimate had been drawn from inventories?
e: Reuters attributed the nearly one-billion-barrel estimate to ADNOC's chief executive.

q: At which exhibition did Naval Group cite the $122 billion naval-production estimate?
e: Reuters reported that Naval Group cited the study at Euronaval in Paris.

q: Which central bank's vice-president raised these financial-stability concerns on 2 November?
e: Reuters attributed the warning to ECB Vice-President Boris Vujcic.

q: Which public-facing systems were reported compromised in both Ukraine and Russia?
e: Associated Press reported false alerts through emergency-warning mobile apps.

q: Which country held the rotating UN Security Council presidency in November 2026?
e: The United Nations identified Latvia as November's rotating Council president.

o: From seven days to two days
From two days to seven days
From thirty days to fourteen days
From fourteen days to thirty days

q: Which Pakistani policy was cited during the 2 November 2026 industrial cooperation talks with Bangladesh?
e: Pakistan's industry adviser briefed the Bangladeshi delegation on the New Energy Vehicle Policy and potential battery and EV manufacturing collaboration.

q: According to Reuters on 3 November 2026, what was the reported price of a 12-kg LPG cylinder after the border disruptions?
e: Reuters reported a 56% increase to Rs7,000 for a 12-kg LPG cylinder following Iran border closures. Source: Reuters.

q: Germany's first November 2026 backup-power tender awarded approximately how much capacity?
e: Germany's November 2026 backup-power tender awarded approximately 5.16 GW of capacity. Source: Reuters.

q: According to UNEP's Adaptation Gap Report 2026, annual developing-country adaptation needs by 2035 are estimated at:
e: UNEP's 2026 Adaptation Gap Report estimates annual developing-country adaptation needs of approximately US$305 billion by 2035. Source: United Nations Environment Programme.

q: Which executive order underpinned the US Treasury's 4 November 2026 maritime sanctions designations?
e: On 4 November 2026 the US Treasury cited Executive Order 13902 for sanctions against an alleged Iranian-oil false-flag maritime network. Source: U.S. Department of the Treasury.

q: The eighth Climate Survey released on 5 November 2026 was published by which institution?
e: The European Investment Bank published its eighth Climate Survey on 5 November 2026, drawing on about 23,000 respondents across 27 EU countries.

q: France relocated the G7 foreign ministers' meeting scheduled for 9–10 November 2026 from Marseille to which city?
e: France's foreign ministry confirmed that the G7 foreign ministers' meeting would be held in Paris instead of Marseille.

q: The West Peron offshore area, designated for a proposed carbon-storage project in November 2026, lies near which Australian city?
e: Australia designated the West Peron offshore seabed near Darwin for a proposed Inpex carbon storage project; further environmental and licensing approvals are required.

q: Approximately how many rallies did French trade unions plan for their nationwide 5 November 2026 protests?
e: Unions planned around 260 demonstrations against living costs and conditions in public services.

q: In the Associated Press 2026 US midterm Voter Poll, nearly nine in ten voters regarded which issue as a major or crucial factor?
e: AP's poll of approximately 100,000 voters found that nearly nine in ten identified the cost of living as a major or crucial factor.
